title: The Moonstone
author: Wilkie Collins
firstLine: I address these lines—written in India—to my relatives in England.
begins: The Prologue is a family paper about the storming of Seringapatam in 1799, where John Herncastle seizes a sacred yellow diamond. The story then begins with the house-steward Gabriel Betteredge in 1848, citing Robinson Crusoe.
happens: The Moonstone, a diamond taken from an Indian shrine, passes to Rachel Verinder on her eighteenth birthday and vanishes from her room that night. Sergeant Cuff suspects Rachel herself. The housemaid Rosanna Spearman, who loves Franklin Blake, kills herself at the Shivering Sand. Rachel refuses to explain and breaks with Franklin. The truth emerges through Ezra Jennings: Franklin took the stone while unknowingly drugged with opium, and gave it to Godfrey Ablewhite, who kept it. Godfrey is smothered in a London lodging, and the evidence points to the Indians. Rachel marries Franklin, and the diamond is back in the forehead of the deity.
